text:
leila_cs: Heads up team 12 - Renewal amendment for LumaGrid coming due next week. Procurement is asking for split billing across two entities and a 6-month term instead of annual. They also requested onboarding to begin as soon as PO is issued. Need alignment on pricing and internal approvals.
mike_sales: looping in @dina_legal @sam_fin. Any legal/policy blockers for multi-entity SOWs?
dina_legal: We can do multi-entity billing but need separate invoice lines and explicit entity identifiers in the SOW. Also confirm tax withholdings per region. No policy blocker but will require countersign workflow.
sam_fin: Finance note 12 - For 6mo term we lose annual discount. With usual proration we'd land at ~54% of annual list. To keep it customer-friendly we could apply a small uplift; propose +4% on the pro-rated subtotal. Need product signoff.
neal_ops: Ops: if onboarding starts pre-sign we can do view-only provisioning and pre-kickoff workshops, but full SSO and seat activations must wait for signed contract/PO.
marco_onboard: Can reserve 2 enablement seats and 8 hours of onboarding at risk, but need explicit written confirmation from customer that they accept terms pending formal signature.
ike_sales: Sent preliminary PO template and amendment draft to customer at 1725020500. Asked for vendor code and PO upload.
renewal-bot: Reminder 12 - renewal lumaGrid in 4 days. Tasks: pricing approval, DocuSign amendment, PO template sent.
leila_cs: Customer replied offering 6mo at +4% and keeping 2 onboarding credits. They will try to get PO uploaded this week.
mike_sales: Great. I'll prepare DocuSign amendment and route for countersign once PO is received.
dina_legal: I'll prepare the SOW billing language and tax appendix. Please add EMEA VAT number if available.
sam_fin: Once PO is uploaded we'll map vendor code and issue separate invoices per entity per SOW lines.
leila_cs: Marking as non-standard in renewal tracker and adding 'start-on-PO' flag.
marco_onboard: Noted. Will stand by to run kickoff once view access confirmed.

---

PO template snippet shared with customer:
```
Billing Line 1:
- Entity: LumaGrid US (EIN: 98-7654321)
- Scope: US seats + onboarding credits
Billing Line 2:
- Entity: LumaGrid EU (VAT: IE12345678)
- Scope: EU seats
Vendor Code: LG-2026
Payment Terms: Net30 (PO required)
```

mike_sales: Follow-up scheduled EOD if no PO. :thumbsup:
